rows.name: The Venetian Resort
rows.address: 3325 Las Vegas Blvd S, Las Vegas, NV
rows.address_note: Clark County Department of Business License, General Information Guide for Transient Lodging Establishments, licensed-establishment table record 1000389.RES-001: "Venetian Resort Hotel Casino / Palazzo Resort Hotel Casino | 3325 Las Vegas Blvd S | Las Vegas | NV | Licensed | 13.38% | RES | 1 | Transient Lodging Tax - Resort Hotel (PGC)" (read 2026-11-17). The county record supplies the street address; the operator's own resort map shows the complex between Sands Avenue and Las Vegas Blvd with the poker room on level 2 of the Grand Canal Shoppes.
rows.resort_fee_note: Official hotel terms: "The Venetian Resort has a standard Las Vegas Resort Fee of $55 plus applicable tax per night, payable upon check-in."
rows.tax_note: Taxing authority: licence 1000389.RES-001, "Venetian Resort Hotel Casino / Palazzo Resort Hotel Casino", 3325 Las Vegas Blvd S, Las Vegas NV, status Licensed, transient lodging tax rate 13.38%, category Resort Hotel (PGC) (Clark County Department of Business License, General Information Guide for Transient Lodging Establishments, Appendix III and the licensed-establishment table; the licensed-establishment table as of April 2021). Appendix III sets the combined rate for a Resort Hotel in the Stadium District and Primary Gaming Corridor at 13.38% (5.5 + 2 + 1 + 1 + 3 + .88), rates effective 3-1-17. The operator's own current terms agree: "Daily rates do not include the applicable Clark County Room Tax of 13.38%."
rows.room_rate_note: Official poker suite page: suite rates "will start as low as $119 and $209 and can be higher", conditional on qualifying poker play (6 hours of live cash play or a $300+ tournament buy-in per night) and on availability; book by calling 866.255.8936 with code EPOKR25. The page does not say which rate applies to which tower or date. Logged official booking-engine quote on 2026-11-17 for Nov 18-20 (2 adults): room charges $204.25 and $524.25 a night, $55.00 resort fee each night, taxes $112.19, total $950.69 (see data/rates.json). It is not copied into room_rate_usd because the rate changes by night.
rows.parking_note: Official hotel terms: "The daily fee for registered hotel guests is $20/day, seven days a week. For non-hotel guests, the fee is $20, Monday - Thursday, and $25/day Friday - Sunday. Valet parking is $40/day." Official poker page: players who play three hours or more get complimentary self-parking.
rows.incidentals_note: Official hotel terms (read 2026-11-17): "A credit card incidental deposit of $150 per night is required upon check-in for suite charging privileges for non-Signature Suites. Signature Suite incidental deposits require a minimum of $500 for Penthouse suites or $2,500 for Presidential suites per stay." Refundable and not part of the room charge, but it is money held at check-in.
rows.extra_guest_note: Official hotel terms: "For reservations with more than 2 guests per suite, a charge of $50 is added to the daily rate for each additional guest 13 years of age or older." Every quote in the rate log is for 2 adults, so this charge does not apply to them.
rows.cancellation_note: Official hotel terms: "A deposit for your stay, including suite, fee, and tax, will be billed upon reservation confirmation." "Check-out prior to your scheduled departure date will result in an additional charge of $100 plus tax." Prepaid offers are non-cancellable and non-refundable, and "if you do not check-in nor notify us\ ... your entire reservation will be canceled and your deposit for the first night's stay will not be refunded". A fixed free-cancellation deadline is not published for general rates.
rows.check_in_out: Check-in 3:00 p.m. - 11:59 p.m.; check-out 11:00 a.m. (official hotel terms)
rows.walk_note: The poker room is inside the Venetian/Palazzo complex (The Palazzo, level 2, Grand Canal Shoppes), so no street walking is needed; the published walking time for the outside legs is blank because no official source publishes it.
rows.true_cost_note: Taken from the official booking engine quote in data/rates.json: 2027-01-01 to 2027-01-06, 5 nights, checkout total $4,559.30, i.e. $911.86 per night after room, resort fee and tax.

method: True cost per night is the official booking engine's own checkout total (room charges + resort fee + taxes) divided by the number of nights in that quote. It is filled in only when the property has a dated quote in the rate log, so nothing is reconstructed from an assumed rate: the printed figures are (room + fee) x (1 + verified room tax), and that identity is re-checked for every entry in data/rates.json. data/rates.json keeps every quote separately with its date, room type, occupancy, cancellation terms and source URL.
